findings.title: False unit-central-support lemma in globalization
findings.original_claim: Orb(1_K',b z) != 0 iff z belongs to the unit centre, assuming b in K' and Zregularity
findings.verification: Complete original-hypothesis counterexample and positive-open-set proof in report Section3; exact matrix identities in independent_checks.json
findings.witness: Q3(s),s^2=2; a=1+s,c=4+2s; B=[[1,c],[1,0]], B'=[[1,0],[1,c]], D=diag(1/3,3), z=(9,3I2). B B*= [[9,1],[1,1]], B' B'^*=D B B* D. Integral Q Q*=s w2 transports to actual paper model.
assumptions_checked: b in K' and matching gamma in K
Actual Part2 Hermitian model via integral Q
z not unit; explicit h1,h2 puts bz inside K'
findings.counterevidence: Finite S may be enlarged to exclude places where the nonzero invariants are nonunits; no main-theorem counterexample.
findings.impact: False lemma supplies central local factors for Proposition11.4; p85 cancellation leads to Theorem11.1 and then mainTheorem2.12.
findings.repair: Enlarge S to make traceA and d units; correct norm scalings. With r=v(z1),t=v(z2), integrality gives t-r>=0,t>=0; unit determinant gives (n+1)t-nr=0, hence r=t=0.
findings.repair_verified: Local lemma and finite-enlargement justification proved; full revised global proof not certified

independent_verification.source_claim_check: Lemma 11.5 assumes nonzero regular invariants, not unit trace(A) and d. Native auxiliary direct reads of the original source and full report confirm this exact distinction and its use in Proposition 11.4, Theorem 11.1 and main Theorem 2.12.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: Over Q3(s), s^2=2, a=1+s and c=4+2s have norms -1 and 8. The integral B=[[1,c],[1,0]] and B'=[[1,0],[1,c]] yield BB*=[[9,1],[1,1]] and B'B'*=[[1,1],[1,9]]=diag(1/3,3)BB*diag(1/3,3). Trace9 and d1 are nonzero, off-diagonal product1 ensures regularity, and integral transport Q Q*=s w2 fits the paper's Hermitian model. The nonunit central element (9,3I2) moves into compact support on a positive open Haar set. Independent exact matrix calculations were actually executed by the auxiliary (PID58060, exit0).
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: Enlarging the finite exceptional set to make trace(A) and d units is allowed locally. The corrected valuation inequalities t-r>=0, t>=0 and (n+1)t-nr=0 force r=t=0. This verifies the local repair and finite-enlargement justification, not a rewritten full global argument.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: The false support lemma supplies central local factors in globalization, so Major is justified without claiming that the fundamental lemma itself is false.

independent_verification.source_claim_check: Lemma 10.6 quantifies over the full rational G'(F) orbit; Lemma 8.6 supplies the narrower integral normalization. The report distinguishes these scopes.

Transport of the Hermitian form 1 to 9 changes the fixed spherical relative character J from1 to-1 while I remains1. The contragredient also contributes -1 rather than cancelling the example. Generic tempered unramified representation and finite nonzero normalization conditions are retained.

findings.title: Integrality does not imply containment through the fixed lattice
findings.original_claim: T=xx* integral iff x*Lambda subset Lambda subset x^-1Lambda
findings.verification: Section5: h=C diag(3,1/3)C^-1 is unitary, x=diag(1,2)h, T=diag(1,4) regular integral, but L=h^-1Lambda selfdual differs fromLambda. Both fixed containments fail.
assumptions_checked: Split standard form and selfdual lattice
findings.counterevidence: Following paragraph correctly varies L'=uLambda; Remark3.9 says density interpretation unused.
findings.impact: Incorrect local explanation, no demonstrated effect on main integral/Hecke reduction.
findings.repair: T integral iff L subset Ldual; xu integral iff L subset uLambda subset Ldual.
findings.repair_verified: Both equivalences proved by multiplication and duality

independent_verification.source_claim_check: The paragraph after (3.8) uses the fixed lattice between x*Lambda and x^-1Lambda; the following paragraph correctly permits a variable selfdual lattice.
independent_verification.hypotheses_and_decisive_check: With h=C diag(3,1/3) C^-1 unitary and x=diag(1,2)h, T=xx*=diag(1,4) is regular integral. The selfdual L=h^-1Lambda differs from Lambda (the relevant entries have denominator3), so both fixed-containment claims fail. Unramifiedness, invertibility, the split form and positive density are preserved.
independent_verification.counterevidence_and_repair: T integral is equivalent to L subset Ldual; xu integral is equivalent to L subset uLambda subset Ldual. Direct multiplication/duality verifies both repairs. Remark3.9 identifies this density interpretation as unused.
independent_verification.dependency_and_severity: A false local lattice explanation with no demonstrated main-theorem dependency; retain Minor.
